rollups.text: The user’s footwear and shopping plans: bought Nike running shoes at an outlet mall in April 2023 for 20% off and prefers Nike for running; runs a daily 5K and wants the same or a similar-fitting model (2023-04..2023-05-29); had new Merrell hiking boots and wanted hiking socks (2023-05-25); discarded worn-out Adidas Superstar shoes and wanted similar casual shoes (2023-05-25); bought comfortable black leather boots and planned to wear them for the first time to dinner on 2023-05-29; recently bought sandals and was excited to wear them in summer; planned to buy gym shoes and was considering Reebok CrossFit shoes after good experiences with Nike (2023-05-29).

Fitness and endurance timeline: began taking long walks in a nearby park in Oakdale, California, when the weather cooled in October 2022; ran a 5K in 31 minutes 45 seconds in January 2023; started attending yoga twice weekly near work in February 2023 and noticed less soreness after runs and bike rides; completed a 30-mile local cycling-club ride on 2023-04-17, averaging 18 mph on a mostly flat route with a favorable tailwind; by 2023-05-26 was considering a June 2023 10K, wanted to build on the 5K time, planned core and glute strength training, and hoped to increase yoga to three times per week; also planned to participate in a cycling event in June 2023. Key span: October 2022 to 2023-06, about eight months.

Local sales of homemade jams and preserves: the user lives in Oakdale, California, makes jams and preserves, and wants to sell them at local events; weekdays are possible but weekends are preferred, and the user had already participated in the Downtown Farmers Market and Night Market (2023-05-21). The user sought additional farmers’ markets, craft fairs, and food festivals; suggestions included markets and festivals around Modesto, Riverbank, Turlock, and Oakdale (2023-05-21). The assistant described possible vendor requirements, fees, and deadlines for the Modesto Farmers’ Market and Oakdale Cowboy Museum Craft Fair, but advised verifying all details directly (2023-05-21).

Professional-network meetup planning: on 2023-05-28 the user was considering organizing another meetup, possibly in June, with a panel discussion. The user had met Sarah, who works at Google, at TechCon during the preceding week and considered inviting her as a panelist; the assistant recommended confirming her availability and expertise and defining the topic and format. The user planned to contact Sarah through LinkedIn and follow up by email if she did not respond within a few days. The user also planned a personalized message to John from StartupABC about attending or participating. Separately, the user had discussed case studies with Emily at a Digital Marketing conference in February 2023 and needed to send them; advice was to send them without waiting for meetup responses. As of 2023-05-28, the panel and outreach were plans, with no confirmed participation recorded.

The user’s theater participation and interests: by 2023-05-24 the user had been watching plays and musicals and planned to try Avenue Q; they were also considering an improv class or workshop. The user takes acting classes on Tuesday nights and felt they had made real progress; on 2023-05-28 they had recently auditioned for a community-theater production of Agatha Christie’s The Mousetrap and hoped to be cast. The user also reads about women’s roles and challenges in theater and values representation and diversity onstage and behind the scenes. No casting outcome is recorded.

The user planned to attend yoga twice per week beginning in February 2023 and, by 2023-05-26, planned to increase to three sessions per week. The user reported less muscle soreness after runs and bike rides since starting yoga. This is a change in planned weekly frequency from two to three sessions; the increase was prospective, not confirmed as completed.
